style.exercise: Clean semi-realistic 3D character render, matte finish, smooth studio look. A single athletic adult man, mid-30s, short dark hair, SHIRTLESS with a bare torso, wearing charcoal athletic shorts and grey training shoes. No shirt, no vest, no tank top. Gym equipment in desaturated mid-grey brushed steel with matte black padding. BACKGROUND: a completely plain, very dark near-black charcoal backdrop, hex #1C1F27, much darker than the figure. No floor line, no horizon, no wall, no room, no windows, no other people, no clutter. EXACTLY ONE piece of equipment in the frame — the single machine being used. No second machine, no duplicate cable tower, no extra frame or rack, and nothing at all behind the figure. The background must be dark, not mid-grey. Soft broad key light from the upper left, gentle rim light along the far edge of the body, no harsh shadows. FRAMING: tight crop. The man and the equipment together fill almost the whole frame, touching or nearly touching the top and bottom edges. Very little empty background. MUSCLE HIGHLIGHT: the target muscle is lit from within with a soft lime-green (#D3F26A) luminescence beneath the skin. It must trace the muscle's TRUE ANATOMICAL FORM at full size — covering the entire muscle belly, both left and right sides symmetrically where the muscle is paired, spanning the muscle's whole real extent across the body. It is NOT a small patch, blob, dot or spot in the middle of the body. The glow fades softly into the surrounding skin with no hard outline or border. It must read as illuminated muscle tissue under translucent skin, and must NOT look like a garment, bra, crop top, vest, sticker, painted patch or hard-edged shape. Absolutely no text, numbers, logos, watermarks, arrows or labels anywhere in the image. 3:2 landscape.
style.muscle: Clean semi-realistic 3D anatomical render, matte finish. Two views of the same standing male figure side by side in one square image: anterior (front) view on the left, posterior (back) view on the right. Athletic adult man, mid-30s, shirtless, plain charcoal shorts, barefoot. Neutral standing pose, arms hanging slightly away from the body, feet shoulder-width. Both figures the same size, aligned, evenly lit, both filling most of the frame vertically. BACKGROUND: completely plain, very dark near-black charcoal, hex #1C1F27, no floor line, no room. The background must be dark, not mid-grey. Soft broad key light from the upper left. The whole body in matte neutral grey-tan. ONLY the named muscle is tinted bright lime green (#D3F26A), following its true anatomical outline and natural striations, with softly feathered edges. Every other muscle stays neutral grey-tan. The tint must read as muscle tissue beneath translucent skin, never as clothing or a painted patch. Absolutely no text, labels, leader lines, logos or watermarks. 1:1 square.

items.prompt: Direct side view from his left. He is seated in a chest press machine, back flat against a tall vertical backrest, feet flat on the floor. Both hands grip handles at chest height and press them FORWARD, horizontally away from his chest, to almost-straight arms. The elbows stay tucked in toward the ribcage, not flared wide to the sides. The two weights stay parallel, level and about shoulder-width apart, and do NOT touch or converge. This is a straight-line PRESS, not a fly or a butterfly — the arms never open outwards in a wide sweeping arc. BOTH pectoral muscles glow lime across their full width, from the breastbone out to each shoulder.

Side view. He lies on an adjustable bench whose backrest is only slightly raised from flat — about one third of the way up from horizontal to vertical, clearly much closer to flat than to upright. He presses two dumbbells straight up above his upper chest. Glutes and lower back flat on the pad with no arch. The elbows stay tucked in toward the ribcage, not flared wide to the sides. The two weights stay parallel, level and about shoulder-width apart, and do NOT touch or converge. This is a straight-line PRESS, not a fly or a butterfly — the arms never open outwards in a wide sweeping arc. BOTH pectoral muscles glow lime — two symmetrical fan-shaped slabs spanning from the breastbone out to each shoulder, with the upper portion nearest the collarbones brightest.

Side view. He lies on a bench whose backrest is raised only about one third of the way from flat to vertical, inside a Smith machine — a fixed barbell running on two vertical steel rails either side. The bar is lowered to upper-chest level. Back flat on the pad. The elbows stay tucked toward the ribs, not flared wide. BOTH pectoral muscles glow lime across their full width, upper portion brightest.

Side view. He lies on a flat bench pressing a barbell straight up above his mid-chest, glutes firmly on the bench, lower back completely flat with no arch, feet planted. Elbows tucked toward the ribs, not flared wide. BOTH pectoral muscles glow lime across their full width.

Front three-quarter view. He is seated in a pec deck machine, back against the vertical pad, forearms flat against two tall vertical pads, bringing them together in front of his chest. This is a FLY: the arms sweep in a wide arc out to the sides with a fixed slight bend at the elbow. It is not a press. BOTH pectoral muscles glow lime across their full width.

Side view. He is seated in a shoulder press machine with a tall backrest supporting his whole spine, pressing two handles straight up overhead. Torso upright and still, not leaning back. The elbows stay in the plane of the body, not flared far back. ONLY the anterior deltoids — the front cap of each shoulder glow lime. Every other muscle — chest, shoulders, torso, arms, legs — stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint, wash or spill anywhere else on the body.

Front view. He sits upright on the end of a bench, torso perfectly vertical and motionless, raising two dumbbells out sideways to exactly shoulder height, leading with the elbows, arms slightly bent, shoulders down not shrugged. BOTH side deltoids glow lime — the full outer cap of each shoulder, not a small dot.

Front three-quarter view. He sits upright on a bench beside a SINGLE cable tower — one column only, nothing behind him. The cable runs from a LOW pulley near floor level, across in front of his body, up to a single D-handle in his far hand. He raises that arm out sideways to shoulder height. Torso vertical and still. ONLY the lateral deltoid — the outer cap of the working shoulder glow lime. Every other muscle — chest, shoulders, torso, arms, legs — stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint, wash or spill anywhere else on the body.

Side three-quarter view. He lies face-down with his chest pressed flat against a bench pad raised roughly halfway between flat and vertical, clearly supported by it, head above the top edge. He raises two dumbbells out sideways and slightly upward. This is a FLY: the arms sweep in a wide arc out to the sides with a fixed slight bend at the elbow. It is not a press. His chest stays in contact with the pad throughout. BOTH rear deltoids glow lime — the full rounded rear cap of each shoulder.
Side three-quarter view. He sits facing into a reverse pec deck machine with his chest against the front pad, sweeping two handles backwards and outwards. Rear deltoids glowing lime.

Side view, close on the upper body. He is SEATED on a bench with a tall high backrest, his back flat against it. Both hands hold the two ends of a rope attachment BEHIND HIS HEAD, at the base of his skull, with the elbows bent and pointing UP toward the ceiling either side of his ears. From there he extends his forearms upward and slightly forward, straightening the arms overhead. The rope comes from a cable behind the bench, below shoulder level, running up past his shoulder. He is NOT pulling anything down and NOT reaching forward — the hands start low behind the head and finish high above it. ONLY the triceps on the back of both upper arms glow lime. Every other muscle stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint or spill.

Side view. He stands upright and braced facing a SINGLE cable tower to one side of him — one column only, nothing behind him. The cable runs from a HIGH pulley at the very TOP of that tower, well ABOVE his head, and comes DOWNWARD to his hands. He grips a straight metal bar attachment with both hands, elbows pinned tight to his sides, and pushes the bar straight down to full arm extension at hip height. Torso vertical, no forward lean. ONLY the triceps on the back of both upper arms glow lime. Every other muscle — chest, shoulders, torso, arms, legs — stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint, wash or spill anywhere else on the body.

Rear three-quarter view from behind and slightly to his left, so his back is visible. He is seated at a lat pulldown machine with his thighs secured under a padded restraint, pulling a wide bar down toward his upper chest, elbows driving down toward his ribs. Chest tall, minimal lean. ONLY the latissimus dorsi — the broad wings down the sides of the back glow lime. Every other muscle — chest, shoulders, torso, arms, legs — stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint, wash or spill anywhere else on the body.
Front view. He hangs from a pull-up bar on an assisted pull-up machine, knees resting on a padded platform that counterbalances him, pulling his chest up toward the bar. Lats glowing lime.

Side three-quarter view. He lies face-down on a bench whose pad is raised roughly halfway between flat and vertical, his chest and stomach pressed flat against that pad and clearly supported by it, head and shoulders above the top edge. He rows two dumbbells up and back, elbows driving past his ribs, shoulder blades squeezing together. His torso never leaves the pad. Upper back and lats glowing lime.

Side view. He stands upright and braced facing a SINGLE cable tower — one column only, nothing behind him. The cable runs from a HIGH pulley at the top of the tower, above head height, down to a straight bar he holds with both hands. Arms almost straight, he sweeps the bar down in a wide arc from head height to his thighs, hinging only at the shoulders. Ribs down, torso rigid. ONLY the latissimus dorsi down the sides of the back glow lime. Every other muscle — chest, shoulders, torso, arms, legs — stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint, wash or spill anywhere else on the body.

Side view. He sits back against a bench backrest raised roughly halfway between flat and vertical, arms hanging straight down and slightly behind the line of his torso, curling two dumbbells up. Biceps glowing lime.

Side view. He stands upright facing a SINGLE cable tower — one column only, nothing behind him. The cable runs from a LOW pulley at the very BOTTOM of the tower, near floor level, up to a straight bar he holds with both hands. Elbows tucked at his sides, curling the bar up toward his chest. Torso vertical and still. ONLY the biceps on the front of both upper arms glow lime. Every other muscle — chest, shoulders, torso, arms, legs — stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint, wash or spill anywhere else on the body.

Side view. He is seated in a horizontal seated leg press: upright seat, tall backrest, and a large flat vertical foot platform directly in front of him at hip height. Not a 45-degree sled. BOTH of his feet are pressed FLAT AGAINST THE FACE OF THE VERTICAL FOOT PLATFORM, side by side, soles in full contact with it and clearly bearing load — neither foot is on the floor and no foot is hanging in the air. His legs are extended forwards toward the platform with the knees bent at a comfortable mid-range angle, thighs roughly horizontal. Back flat against the backrest, hips square. ONLY the quadriceps on the front of both thighs glow lime. Every other muscle stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint or spill.
Side view. He is seated in a leg extension machine, back against a tall backrest, shins behind a padded roller, extending both legs out to straight without locking the knees hard. Quads glowing lime.

Side view. He is seated in a seated hamstring curl machine with a tall backrest and a thigh restraint pad, pulling his heels down and back under the seat against a padded roller. Hamstrings glowing lime.

Side view. He lies face-up on the floor on an exercise mat, one knee bent with that foot flat on the floor, the other leg extended straight out. He drives his hips up so his torso and extended leg form a straight line, ribs down, no lower-back arch. Glutes glowing lime.

Side view. He is seated upright in a seated calf raise machine, a padded bar across his thighs, the balls of his feet on a small platform, heels pressed up at the top of the movement. Calves glowing lime.

Front three-quarter view. He stands upright and braced side-on to a SINGLE cable tower — one column only, nothing behind him. The cable runs horizontally from a pulley set at CHEST height to a single handle he presses straight out in front of his sternum with both hands, resisting the cable's pull to twist him. Torso square and unrotated, ribs down. ONLY the obliques along the sides of the waist glow lime. Every other muscle — chest, shoulders, torso, arms, legs — stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint, wash or spill anywhere else on the body.

Front three-quarter view. He is half-kneeling — one knee down on a mat, the other foot forward and flat, torso tall and vertical — side-on to a SINGLE cable tower, one column only, nothing behind him. The cable runs horizontally from a CHEST-height pulley to a handle he presses straight out in front of his sternum with both hands. Torso square and unrotated. ONLY the obliques along the sides of the waist glow lime. Every other muscle — chest, shoulders, torso, arms, legs — stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint, wash or spill anywhere else on the body.

Side view slightly above. He holds a side plank on a mat, supported on one forearm with the elbow under the shoulder and BOTH knees bent and resting on the mat, forming a straight line from knee to shoulder. Hips lifted and stacked, not sagging. Obliques glowing lime.
Side view slightly above. He is on a mat on hands and toes with knees bent at 90 degrees hovering roughly an inch off the floor, back completely flat and level, ribs down. Abdominals glowing lime.
Highlight: Latissimus dorsi, the broad wings down the sides of the back. Visible on the posterior view; leave the anterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: Clavicular pectoralis, the upper chest just below the collarbones. Visible on the anterior view; leave the posterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: The main body of the pectoralis major, mid chest. Visible on the anterior view; leave the posterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: The lower border of the pectoralis major, just above the ribs. Visible on the anterior view; leave the posterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: Rhomboids and mid-trapezius between the shoulder blades. Visible on the posterior view; leave the anterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: Trapezius, the diamond from the neck to the mid-back, plus the upper trapezius ridge visible from the front.

Highlight: the erector spinae — the two vertical muscular columns running either side of the spine in the LOWER back ONLY, in the region between the bottom of the ribcage and the top of the pelvis, level with the waistband. Do NOT highlight the upper back, the shoulder blades, the trapezius or the lats. Visible on the posterior view; leave the anterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: Anterior deltoid, the front of both shoulders. Visible on the anterior view; leave the posterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: Lateral deltoid, the outer cap of both shoulders. Visible on both views.
Highlight: Posterior deltoid, the rear of both shoulders. Visible on the posterior view; leave the anterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: Biceps brachii, the front of both upper arms. Visible on the anterior view; leave the posterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: Triceps brachii, the back of both upper arms. Visible on the posterior view; leave the anterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: The forearm flexors and extensors of both lower arms. Visible on both views.
Highlight: Quadriceps, the front of both thighs. Visible on the anterior view; leave the posterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: Hamstrings, the back of both thighs. Visible on the posterior view; leave the anterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: Gluteus maximus, both buttocks. Visible on the posterior view; leave the anterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: The adductors of the inner thighs. Visible on the anterior view; leave the posterior view entirely neutral.
Highlight: Gastrocnemius and soleus, the back of both lower legs. Visible on the posterior view, and along the sides of the lower legs on the anterior view.
Highlight: Rectus abdominis, the central abdominal column. Visible on the anterior view; leave the posterior view entirely neutral.

Highlight: the oblique muscles on the LEFT and RIGHT SIDES of the waist — the flanks, running diagonally down the sides of the torso between the lower ribs and the hip bones. Do NOT highlight the central abdominal six-pack down the middle of the stomach; that central strip must stay neutral. Visible from the front and the sides.

Front three-quarter view. He is seated in a hip abduction machine — an upright seat with a backrest and two large vertical pads on the OUTER sides of his knees. His back is flat against the backrest, torso upright and not leaning forward. He pushes both knees OUTWARD away from each other against the pads, legs spread wide at the end of the movement. ONLY the gluteus medius and minimus on the outer upper hip of each side glow lime. Every other muscle stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint or spill.

Front three-quarter view. He is seated in a hip adduction machine — an upright seat with a backrest and two large vertical pads on the INNER sides of his knees, legs starting apart. His back is flat against the backrest, torso upright. He squeezes both knees INWARD toward each other against the pads. ONLY the adductors on the inner thigh of each leg glow lime. Every other muscle stays completely un-highlighted in normal matte skin tone, with no green tint or spill.

Highlight: the gluteus medius and gluteus minimus — the muscles on the OUTER upper hip, above and to the side of the gluteus maximus, in the region between the top of the pelvis and the hip joint. Do NOT highlight the main gluteus maximus buttock mass or the outer thigh below the hip. Visible on both the posterior and anterior views as the outer curve of the upper hip.
